remarks:
Great Location with Scenic Country Views! Discover the possibilities with this approximately 5+/- acre parcel on Dutch Hill Road in the Town of Ashford. Being subdivided from a larger parcel, the final acreage and boundaries will be determined by survey.

The property offers approximately 350 feet of road frontage and extends approximately 620 feet deep. A short driveway is already in place, and the front portion of the property has been cleared approximately 200 feet back from the road, providing an open area with beautiful views of the surrounding countryside.

The terrain features a slight to moderate slope before transitioning to a steeper, wooded area toward the rear of the property. Young ash, cherry, maple, and pine trees, along with natural brush, provide a mix of open and wooded surroundings.

Conveniently located just minutes from Route 219 and Springville, this parcel offers an opportunity to create your own country retreat while maintaining convenient access to nearby amenities. Whether you're considering building a home or simply looking for your own piece of Western New York countryside, this property is well worth a look!
